title: Pure Harpie
summary: Harpie cards only, with generic WIND Extra Deck monsters and staples. Most Harpies count as "Harpie Lady", so every card that names Harpie Lady works with all of them. Harpie Channeler discards a Harpie card to summon another Harpie from the Deck. Harpie Perfumer searches one or two Spells/Traps that name Harpie Lady Sisters. Elegant Egotist calls Harpie Lady Sisters from the Deck, and Hysteric Sign searches three Harpie cards at once. Harpie's Pet Dragon - Fearsome Fire Blast, the newest card, summons itself next to a small WIND monster and protects the smaller Harpies from attacks. Cyber Slash Harpie Lady bounces a card whenever a Spell/Trap activates. Harpie's Feather Duster is Limited, Harpie's Feather Storm is Forbidden, and Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist isn't out in the TCG yet.

exclude.Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist: Not released in the TCG yet.
exclude.Toon Harpie Lady: Needs Toon World; it plays on the Toon list.

main: Harpie Channeler
Starter: discards a Harpie card to summon a Harpie from the Deck.
Harpie Perfumer
Searches a Spell/Trap that names Harpie Lady Sisters, two with a big Harpie out.
Harpie Oracle
Summons itself next to a big Harpie; recovers a Harpie Spell/Trap.
Harpie Harpist
Bounces your Winged Beast and their monster; searches a small Winged Beast.
Harpie's Pet Dragon - Fearsome Fire Blast
Newest: summons itself; shields the smaller Harpies from attacks.
Harpie Dancer
Bounces a WIND monster for another Normal Summon.
Harpie Queen
Discards to search Harpies' Hunting Ground.
Harpie Lady Sisters
The target Elegant Egotist calls from the Deck.
Elegant Egotist
Summons a Harpie Lady or Harpie Lady Sisters from the hand or Deck.
Hysteric Sign
Searches Elegant Egotist; searches three Harpie cards when it leaves.
Harpies' Hunting Ground
Field Spell: destroys a Spell/Trap on each Harpie summon.
Harpie's Feather Duster
Limited: destroys every Spell/Trap they control.
Harpie's Feather Rest
Recycles three Harpies to draw one or two.
Harpie Lady Phoenix Formation
Destroys a monster per Harpie and burns.
Alluring Mirror Split
Summons a Harpie from the Deck when one falls in battle.
Harpie Lady Elegance
Trades Harpie Lady Sisters for three Harpies from the hand, Deck and GY.
Hysteric Party
Discards to revive every Harpie Lady in the GY.
